brief:
Gaza's sports sector has been severely damaged by ongoing conflict, with war destroying much of the infrastructure needed to sustain athletic programs and facilities, the Palestine News Network reported. The damage mirrors broader destruction affecting everyday life across the territory.

PNN's program "Ala Al-Makshouf" examined how the conflict has pushed sports to the margins in Gaza, where athletes and sports organizations struggle to operate amid widespread devastation.
dek: BETHLEHEM, West Bank (PNN) — In Gaza, where war has damaged much of the infrastructure needed for everyday life, sports have also been pushed to the margins.
title: War devastates Gaza's sports infrastructure and athletic programs
